MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The exterior wood screws fit my recent purchases of outdoor and construction screws because they serve similar wood-fastening needs.",
    "The #8 x 1-3/4-inch screws felt like a useful next choice because their shorter length could complement the longer screws I recently bought."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The 16-gauge finish nails missed my current needs: my recent nail purchases were framing nails, and similar lengths do not establish the same purpose or nailer compatibility.",
    "The peg locks and sealing primer require specific projects I have not shown a need for, while buying vacuum bags does not establish a need for liquid cleaner.",
    "The #10 x 3-1/2-inch screws fit my interests but overlap with the #10 x 4-inch screws I just bought, so I have less reason to choose them now."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My nail purchases seemed to be treated as interest in nails generally, even though framing and finish nails serve different jobs.",
    "My purchases of repair supplies and vacuum bags seemed to imply broader needs for workshop accessories, surface treatments, and cleaning products."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The fastener's intended job, dimensions, and tool compatibility matter more to me than simply being another nail or screw.",
    "I am more interested in a useful complementary screw length than another option close to what I recently purchased.",
    "My scattered purchases of medicine cups and vacuum bags reflect separate needs; they do not establish an ongoing project connecting all household supplies."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my interest in wood fastening, but stretched it beyond my current projects and overlooked the practical differences between fasteners."
}
